nodes.title: SOURCE
widgets_values:
A recent article devoted to the macho side of programming made the bald and unvarnished statement: 


 \textbf{Real Programmers write in FORTRAN.} 


 Maybe they do now, in this decadent era of Lite beer, \hspace{2em}hand calculators, \hspace{4em}and user-friendly software but back in the Good Old Days, when the term software sounded funny and \textbf{Real Computers} were made out of drums and vacuum tubes, Real Programmers wrote in machine code. Not FORTRAN. \hspace{2em}Not RATFOR. \hspace{4em}Not, even, assembly language.
